name: gecici-email
description: Create and read token-protected temporary inboxes for authorized testing through the hosted gecici.email MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Create a receive-only inbox and read its messages, verification codes and links using the private access token. The plugin connects to the hosted gecici.email service; no mail server is installed locally.
defaultPrompt: Create a temporary inbox for my authorized QA test.
Check my temporary inbox for a verification code.
Summarize the latest message in my temporary inbox.
